Read More Mediterranean Cruise – France, Italy & Spain 7 Night Cruise02 October 2026From €1,349 per person sharing (Cruise with Flights included) West Mediterranean 8-Day Western Mediterranean Cruise | Departure 02 October 2026 Set sail aboard the MSC Seaview on an enchanting 7-night voyage through the sparkling waters of the Western Mediterranean. Your journey begins in the lively port city of Marseille, before charting a course toward some of the region’s most captivating coastal treasures. Discover the maritime spirit and architectural beauty of Genoa, then step into the heart of history as you explore Civitavecchia, the gateway to timeless Rome. Embrace the unique Sicilian charm of Palermo and experience the vibrant energy and nightlife of Ibiza. Before returning to Marseille, soak up the cosmopolitan flair and cultural allure of Barcelona. This remarkable itinerary combines rich history, stunning scenery, and Mediterranean vibrance for an unforgettable escape at sea. Call us now on (01) 517 5990 or request a quote by filling out the form at the bottom of the page. Itinerary 7-Night Western Mediterranean Cruise Itinerary | MSC Seaview Day 1: Marseille, France Embark on MSC Seaview from the vibrant city of Marseille where Provence comes crashing into the sea: bustling city and beautiful coastline, Belle Époque facades and bold street art, Provençal and multicultural traditions. France's oldest city is also its most original, appealing to both first-time and seasoned visitors, as you will discover on a Marseille cruise. Day 2: Genoa, Italy Gateway to the Italian Riviera, the Port of Genoa is one of the most important (and one of the largest) in Italy, a strategic harbour since ancient times. Cruises to Genoa offer the opportunity to taste signature dishes made from fresh ingredients, such as pesto Genovese and focaccia. On a Genoa cruise, guests can also admire one of Italy’s most beautiful stretches of coastline or an excursion to the UNESCO-listed Cinque Terre. Its five fishing villages, perched on steep cliffs, offer superb sea views, small seafood restaurants, and a tableau of townhouses. A short trip away from Genoa, Portofino beckons with colourful facades, boutiques and surrounding lush hills. Day 3: Civitavecchia, Italy All roads lead to Rome, the saying goes, and it certainly felt that way through the centuries as Emperors and Popes used their vast wealth to build monuments worthy of this great city. This living history has withstood the test of time. It is still possible to stand in the Colosseum and imagine you are watching a gladiatorial battle, to picture horses racing across the Circus Maximus or to feel divinely inspired in the Pantheon. The entire city centre is a UNESCO World Heritage Site overflowing with history and art, from the curve of the Spanish Steps to the echoing halls of the Vatican Museums. Take your fill of cobbled streets and Baroque masterpieces. Day 4: Palmero, Italy The port of Palermo, is the regional capital of the island of Sicily. This cosmopolitan city is known for its heavenly architecture, serious street food, and outrageously beautiful beaches. Enjoy guided tours and explore the atmospheric streets of Cefalù where you can shop local wares at the craft shops. Day 5: Day At Sea Enjoy a full day at sea onboard MSC Seaview. Take advantage of the pools, spa, entertainment, and dining options as you soak in panoramic Mediterranean views. Day 6: Ibiza, Spain Though primarily known for its party scene, Ibiza, aims to impress with its fortified old town, rich archaeological sites and brilliant array of beaches. Day 7: Barcelona, Spain Barcelona offers experiences and sights for all, from classical and modern art to daring architecture, from innovative design to ancient history, plus world-class gastronomy (covering local cuisine and fine dining) and an enviable coastline. Day 8: Marseille, France Return to France and disembark. If you would like to extend your stay adventure by exploring more of this vibrant city, simply let us know and we will be happy to tailor your experience to your preferences. MSC Cruise Excursions offer plenty of exciting things to see in all destinations! Pricing The starting price for this cruise is €1,349 per person sharing an interior cabin with flights included. Just let us know if you would like to upgrade to a balcony cabin and add a drinks package. A non-refundable deposit of €500 per person is due at time of booking, plus any optional supplements. The remaining balance is due 12 weeks before travel. What's Included Included in your package: 7-night East Mediterranean cruise roundtrip from Marseille Ports of call: Genoa, Civitavecchia, Palermo, Ibiza, Barcelona Return flights from Dublin with luggage allowance. Onboard entertainment & activities All gratuities, taxes and port charges Not included in your package: Airport transfers to and from the cruise ship, however, these can be added. Local tours and activities are not included, but our team will be happy to assist with booking unforgettable experiences in each destination. Travel Insurance, which is a mandatory condition of the booking. Your Cruise Ship Step aboard MSC Seaview, a stylish and innovative ship from MSC Cruises designed to bring you closer to the sea with its unique outdoor-focused layout and modern elegance. Enjoy an abundance of onboard activities, from relaxing by the panoramic pools and ocean-view sundecks to high-energy fitness classes, live music and world-class entertainment for all ages. Children and teens can make new friends in the dedicated kids’ and youth clubs, while adults indulge in the luxurious MSC Aurea Spa, offering a full range of wellness treatments, saunas and a tranquil thermal area. Accommodation options include five distinct cabin types, from cozy interior staterooms to spacious suites with private balconies, ensuring every guest finds their perfect retreat at sea. Dining on MSC Seaview is a culinary adventure, with elegant main restaurants, casual buffets and specialty venues serving everything from Mediterranean favorites to international cuisine. As night falls, immerse yourself in dazzling entertainment at the high-tech theatre, join in lively themed parties, or unwind in one of the many stylish bars and lounges with a cocktail in hand. Whether you're exploring vibrant ports or soaking up the sun at sea, MSC Seaview delivers a contemporary cruise experience full of energy, comfort and unforgettable moments.
